The aim of the BIM is to estimate the impact of introducing Enco + Bini to the currently available treatment mix for patients with BRAF mutated metastatic melanoma from the Canadian healthcare payer perspective over a time horizon of 3 years (with 1 year baseline) (Figure 1). Given that the treatment duration can last more than 1 year for variety for treatments, a cohort -based approach was followed to capture the costs in subsequent years. | Figure 1. BIM structure
